non_negotiable: Manually read every printed page, manually author every new note sentence and MCQ in both languages, manually review the entire finished chapter. No templates or mechanical conversion as substitutes. Ignore handwriting.

workflow.action: Confirm PDF/page image, physical sequence and printed folio. Preserve original bytes. Record cross-chapter assignments; never silently omit or deduplicate distinct leaves.

Inspect the page image line by line, including tables, boxes, captions and diagram labels. Record each atomic fact, concept, relationship, number, exception and printed PYQ. OCR may assist location, never certify reading.

Verify doubtful, outdated or ambiguous statements against authoritative primary sources. Retain the printed claim, corrected teaching claim, source and reason. Unresolved claims remain explicitly qualified and unscored.

Write prerequisites before dependent terms. Integrate the material into the chapter narrative with natural Telugu, English technical terms, connected paragraphs and subheadings. Use tables for genuine comparisons and reference data. Preserve stable anchors and established corrections.

Map every accepted fact and concept to at least one identifiable MCQ; use additional conceptual, application, statement-combination, matching and ordering questions where educationally useful. Author full Telugu and full English separately, four plausible options, unambiguous answer and explanations. Include easy/moderate/hard with reasons; no arbitrary volume target or repetitive permutations.

Save actual question wording and printed options with TG/APPSC/other exam, year and source page. Never label original questions as historical PYQs. Record attribution/key uncertainty and hold scoring until justified.

Read the entire final notes and every question, both language versions, each option, answer and explanation in context. Check prerequisites, natural language, equivalence, factual correctness and absence of ambiguity. Correct manually and reread changed passages.

Check every page-claim→note-anchor→MCQ mapping; no uncovered accepted claim or invented completion. Validate counts, keys, holds, hashes, duplicate IDs, literal excerpts and links. Exercise language switches, filters, answer review, exact note sections and back navigation. Technical tests do not replace editorial review.

Save page-level evidence, completion checklist, test results and exact remaining work. Only mark the chapter complete when all assigned pages and all review gates are satisfied; then proceed to the next World sequence chapter.

efficiency: One chapter at a time; read and author in small page batches; reuse already verified facts and existing good questions after manual review. Scripts only save authored material, maintain evidence and run checks. No new infographics before content freeze.
completion_gate: All source pages accounted for; all accepted claims taught and tested; full notes and both-language MCQs manually reviewed; unresolved claims clearly held; technical checks pass.
deployment: Railway prohibited until user changes the hold
